name: A Dusty Unsent Letter
summary: In Moonbrook, an unsent letter bears on Stalvan Mistmantle’s past. Found in an old footlocker, it confirms that he lived there before his disappearance.

sections.title: A Clue in the Dust
sections.body:
Investigators searching Moonbrook find an unsent letter in an old footlocker. Darkshire’s town registry still lists Stalvan Mistmantle’s last address as the Moonbrook Schoolhouse. Clerk Daltry wants to know if he truly lived there. The letter confirms that Stalvan resided in the Westfall township for a time.

Finding the letter disturbs a vengeful Forlorn Spirit. The spirit guards the remnants of Stalvan’s past with bitter malice.

sections.title: Updating the Registry
sections.body: At Darkshire’s Town Hall, Clerk Daltry receives the letter as evidence for the town registry. He finds it strange that the correspondence was never sent. Its trail hints at Stalvan’s path across the southern kingdoms of the Alliance.

aliases: where to get dusty unsent letter
faq.answer: The letter lies in an abandoned footlocker in Moonbrook, Westfall. Dilapidated houses overrun by the Defias Brotherhood surround it.

faq.q: Why was the letter never sent?
faq.answer: No one knows why the letter was never sent. Clerk Daltry finds this suspicious and suggests Stalvan may have fled Moonbrook in haste or left his correspondence behind before moving on.

faq.q: Who needs to see this letter?
aliases: who do i give the letter to
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry needs to see the letter. He manages the town registry inside Darkshire’s Town Hall.

faq.q: Why does a spirit attack when finding it?
faq.answer: Disturbing the footlocker summons a Forlorn Spirit tied to Stalvan’s haunting legacy. It attacks anyone prying into his forgotten life and afflicts intruders with the debilitating Curse of Stalvan.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can help Darkshire keep accurate records by learning Stalvan’s trail between the human settlements of Westfall and Duskwood.
